Cookie & Local Storage Policy

Effective September 24, 2026 · Version 2.6

Short version. This is a native iOS app. It has no browser, no cookies, no trackers and no third-party embed of any kind. This document is kept because the policy set is referenced as a whole, and because the same question gets asked about local storage.

1. Cookies

This is a native app, not a website: there is no browser context in which a cookie could be set, and the app embeds no web view, analytics tag or ad network that could set one. There is no sign-in state to maintain, because there are no accounts. What the app stores stays in its own container on the device and is never attached to a network request, because the app makes none.

2. Similar technologies we do use

  • Technology — Purpose — Category — Personal data?
  • App container — Settings, presets, sleep history, membership state — Strictly necessary — Yes — encrypted, local only
  • App container (backgrounds) — Background photos you add, and their thumbnails — Strictly necessary — Yes — local only, iOS file protection, not encrypted by Remvoll
  • iOS Keychain — The key protecting the above — Strictly necessary — Yes — local only
  • App bundle — The app's own sounds and assets, installed with the app — Strictly necessary — No
  • UserDefaults — Alarm bookkeeping: the mapping to the system's alarm identifiers, the tone each alarm uses, per-day snooze counts; the last day an upgrade prompt or the rating prompt was shown — Strictly necessary — No

These technologies are essential to deliver the Service you request (for example, to remember your presets and settings, and to work offline). They are not used for tracking, profiling, or advertising.

3. Consent

Under the EU ePrivacy Directive and equivalent guidance, storage that is strictly necessary to provide a service explicitly requested by the user does not require prior consent. Because Remvoll uses only strictly-necessary local storage and performs no tracking, no cookie-consent banner is required. If we ever introduce non-essential storage or any tracking technology, we will request your consent first and provide granular controls.

4. Third parties

There are no third-party analytics libraries, advertising networks, attribution SDKs, or crash-reporting services in the app. It has zero third-party package dependencies.

5. Managing local storage

You can manage or remove locally-stored data at any time using the in-app controls (Settings › Export my data and Settings › Erase sleep history), or by deleting the app, which removes everything associated with the Service in one step, including the encryption key.

6. Changes

If our use of cookies or local storage changes — for example, if a future feature requires new storage — we will update this policy and, where required, obtain consent before that change takes effect.

Questions: privacy@remvoll.com.

Remvoll runs entirely on your device. Questions: legal@remvoll.app
